text:
miriam: Quick sync — assembling the Q3 GTM plan. Need final sales targets, PLG experiments list, launch criteria, and enablement deadlines. Goal: finalize by EOD Fri. Draft top-line: PLG conversion lift +15% MAU -> revenue impact, Sales new ARR target $4.2M, Enablement: 2 playbooks (Enterprise, PLG). Thoughts?

jonah: Love the framing. PLG experiments priority list: onboarding flow A/B (reduce time-to-first-success), paid-upgrade nudges in product, pricing page microtests. Need experiment owners + target metrics (activation, conversion, revenue).

sam: $4.2M feels aggressive given current ramp. Can we split by segment? Proposal: Enterprise $2.2M, Mid-market $1.3M, SMB $0.7M. Also need 60-day lead time for large deals and enablement support on key accounts.

leo: From RevOps: current weighted pipeline supports ~3.6M best-case. If PLG conversion improves 10% we net ~300k. To reach 4.2M we need two large logo closes or a sustained PLG lift +20%. I'll run scenario models.

tess: Product readiness check: Dedicated capacity improvements targeted for July. Proposed launch criteria: latency P95 <120ms for baseline models, canary rollout at 10% traffic, SDK + docs updated, smoke tests passing. Will add checklist to the release ticket.

harry: Customer asks to flag: SOC2 + EU data residency are gating for two deals in pipeline. Private deployment timeline? Eng SRE ETA? Need this surfaced to avoid missing bookings.

emily: Marketing needs a 6-week campaign for product launch and PLG nurture streams. Assets due June 25. We'll queue PR and analyst outreach pending final messaging. Want to secure 2 customer case studies for launch.

anya: Design can turn hero + 3 campaign assets by June 20 if copy/positioning is locked this week. Recommend a lean PLG landing to reduce dev lift.

miriam: Action items: leo — upload updated forecasts by Wed; jonah — assign PLG experiment owners by EOD Tue; tess — add launch checklist + rollout policy; emily — confirm campaign dates and asset list; sam — confirm segment splits with RevOps. If we can't reconcile by Fri EOD we'll move commit deadline +1 week. @here react with :thumbsup: if aligned.

sam: :thumbsup: will confirm segment splits and chase outstanding high-touch deals.

jonah: I'll post experiment owners + success metrics by EOD Tue.

leo: Uploading scenario models tomorrow AM.

tess: Adding checklist items now — will include model-quality guardrail and regression alert thresholds.

emily: Noted on June 25 assets and PR timeline. I'll start outreach to potential case study customers this week.

anya: I'll ping for copy review and share early comps by Fri.

harry: Looping eng-sre on SOC2/residency blockers and will escalate on high-touch deals.

calendar-bot: Event created — "Q3 GTM sync" Wed 10:00 AM (30m).

miriam: One more note — PLG primary metric = D7 activation (baseline to be shared). Also include one quality guardrail for model output regressions in launch criteria (we can't ship without eval pass). Thanks everyone, will consolidate updates into the draft GTM doc and share before EOD Fri.
